title: Spending Tracker Frontend
description: A production-ready dashboard for the spending tracker backend. Users can view transaction analytics, manage budgets and categories, and access AI-powered insights.
problem: Personal-finance dashboards on the market either cost a subscription or felt like spreadsheet cosplay — neither was something I'd want to use daily.
outcome: Production dashboard with auth, budget management, and an AI insights panel. Deployed on Netlify with continuous deploys from main.

title: Spending Tracker Backend
description: RESTful API built with Spring Boot for personal finance tracking. Supports SQLite and MySQL, featuring transaction categorization, budget management, and analytics endpoints.
problem: The frontend needed a stable, well-documented API that could run on SQLite for solo users and MySQL for shared/family use — without forking the codebase.
role: Solo build, REST API design and implementation.
outcome: Spring Boot service with full CRUD, budget math, and analytics endpoints. The same jar runs against either database from a single config flag.

title: Spending Tracker – Full Solution
description: A complete self-hosted solution combining the frontend and backend via Docker Compose for easy deployment.
problem: Hand-rolling a deploy for a 2-service stack is friction nobody wants — wiring env vars, networks, and image tags by hand invites breakage.
outcome: One `docker compose up` brings the full stack online. CI builds and pushes versioned images on every tag, ready to pull.

title: Movie Discovery Website
description: A movie and series streaming platform that fetches content from the TMDB API, featuring browsing, search, and watch functionality.
problem: Finding something worth watching across streaming services is a chore — most apps bury the catalogue behind accounts and recommendations tuned for engagement, not taste.
role: Solo build, frontend with third-party API integration.
outcome: Browse, search, and watch-trailer flow over the TMDB API. Live demo deployed on Netlify.
